items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: His name was Edward Rodney, one of my best friends, and he used to call me Half.

ctx.x: How did that all affect you when you got out as a young kid over the years?

Huh? I can't really recall how it affected me because by being only eleven and twelve years old, stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like the top of it and so forth. For a long time, even to a young man of 20 some odd years old, the inferior complex followed me by being in public and people staring at me and so forth. And there was a schoolmate. He said he succumbed to cancer not three years ago. His name was Edward Rodney, one of my best friends, and he used to call me Half.
